The `end()` function in `LegionCapitalRaise` is guarded by `whenRaiseNotEnded → _verifyCapitalRaiseHasNotEnded()`, which reverts on `s_capitalRaiseStatus.hasEnded == true`. After `end()` sets the flag, no code path resets it, so the one-time invariant holds. Both related sale variants (`LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale`, `LegionPreLiquidOpenApplicationSale`) apply the same pattern with their own `hasEnded` booleans.
